 FORECAST: Wet and windy Wednesday 
 By Tawana Andrew Published : Nov. 4, 2026 at 6:55 AM EST | Updated : 2 hours ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google WEATHER HEADLINES 
 NEXT 12: Rainy through the afternoon; showers/drizzle last into the evening 
 SHORT TERM: Mix of sun and clouds on Thursday; highs in the 60s 
 LONG TERM: Chilly weekend ahead with temperatures in the 50s 
 LATEST FORECAST 
 LOUISVILLE, Ky. (WDRB+WAVE) - Widespread morning rain will gradually push east through the afternoon. Spotty showers and drizzle remain possible into the evening. The clouds and rain will keep us cooler today; temperatures will hover in the 60s throughout the day. 
 Clouds hold on overnight, with drizzle still possible at times. Lows fall into the 40s and low 50s by Thursday morning. 
 Lingering Thursday morning clouds look to clear by the afternoon, allowing us to enjoy more sunshine for the second half of the day. Highs return to the 60s tomorrow afternoon. 
 Clouds move right back into the region Thursday night as lows tumble into the 40s. 
 A quick Friday cold front will keep clouds overhead to end the workweek and limit highs to the 50s. The chilly weather lasts through the weekend, with a slight warm-up next week.
